_comment: Read by scripts/validate.py. Patterns are Python regular expressions. Pricing and part-number checks run on every item's title and summary.

pricing._comment: always: product-pricing language, checked in every category. currency_amounts: any money amount, checked in every category except financial (company-level figures such as revenue are allowed there).

part_numbers._comment: A token that matches any pattern is rejected unless it appears in allowlist (exact, case-sensitive). Family names such as 'IV4', 'SEC200' or 'TBEN-L' do not match the patterns and need no allowlist entry.

redaction_note: The digest never redacts silently. validate.py fails the run instead, and the run author rewrites the item.
